failure_summary.description: Some calls used a broadly related endpoint rather than the endpoint best matched to the requested operation or output.
Distinct requested outputs were missed, including reviews and a mark-price time series.
Calls omitted or mis-mapped qualifiers, used an incorrect canonical value or parameter bucket, or duplicated a parameter key.

patch.reasoning: The observed failures are already covered by the skill’s guidance to match endpoints to documented outputs, reconcile every requested action, map qualifiers to exact schema fields and canonical values, and validate serialization. Adding similar guidance would duplicate existing content rather than patch a demonstrated gap.
